body:
A5's spec text listed triggers "connectivity regained, foreground, manual
pull-to-refresh" — the manual trigger was never built. Current triggers are
foreground, 15-min periodic, and 5s-debounced after local edits. The everyday
failure: two people shopping together with the app open on both phones — one
adds items, the other's screen stays stale for up to 15 minutes with no way to
force a refresh (only backgrounding/foregrounding the app).

Fix: Material pull-to-refresh on ListScreen (and Overview) invoking
SyncEngine.syncNow() directly with a visible spinner; show a lightweight
last-synced indicator (ties into the sync-health surface of the sync-wedge
ticket — coordinate, don't duplicate). Files: ui/list/ListScreen.kt,
ui/overview/OverviewScreen.kt, a small shared "sync now + state" holder.
title: Android: no pull-to-refresh / manual sync + no sync recency indicator
